hero.title: Emerald Yachts: A New Era of Luxury Travel at Sea
hero.subtitle: Emerald Yachts offer a refined, boutique-style yacht experience designed for travelers who value relaxed luxury, coastal access, and an easy, social atmosphere at sea.
readMoreParagraphs: These are not expedition vessels. They are intimate yachts built for warm-weather cruising, scenic coastlines, and destination-driven travel with a lighter pace.
Planning an Emerald Yacht journey is not simply about selecting a sailing. It is about choosing the right itinerary, season, and onboard experience to match how you want your time to feel.

Trips & Ships Luxury Travel designs Emerald Yacht journeys using a structured planning approach led by Angela Hughes, ensuring every detail is aligned from the beginning so the experience feels effortless and well-paced.

intro.title: What Are Emerald Yachts?
intro.description: Emerald Yachts are part of the Scenic Group portfolio and are designed for boutique yacht cruising in warm-weather destinations. With a smaller guest count and an open, relaxed onboard environment, Emerald Yachts focus on lifestyle-driven travel rather than expedition or technical exploration.

experience.title: Real Experience with Emerald Yachts
experience.description: Our experience with Emerald Yachts is not theoretical. We understand how these journeys unfold in real time, how itinerary pacing impacts the feel of the trip, and how small decisions such as sailing selection and cabin placement influence the overall experience.

questions.question: What is included on Emerald Yachts?
questions.answer: Emerald Yachts include accommodations, dining, select beverages, and curated itineraries designed for simplicity and ease.

questions.question: Are Emerald Yachts all-inclusive?
questions.answer: They are largely inclusive, though inclusions vary by itinerary and are not as extensive as expedition yachts.

questions.question: Is Emerald Yachts considered luxury?
questions.answer: Emerald Yachts fall into the premium to boutique luxury category with a relaxed, elevated atmosphere.

questions.question: Is Emerald Yachts worth it?
questions.answer: Yes, for travelers seeking a smaller ship, relaxed pacing, and destination-focused travel.

questions.question: How do Emerald Yachts compare to Scenic Eclipse?
questions.answer: Emerald focuses on warm-weather lifestyle cruising, while Scenic Eclipse focuses on expedition and discovery travel.

questions.question: How do Emerald Yachts compare to traditional cruises?
questions.answer: They offer a more intimate experience with fewer guests, smaller ports, and a quieter onboard environment.

questions.question: What destinations do Emerald Yachts visit?
questions.answer: Primarily the Mediterranean and Caribbean, focusing on coastal and scenic routes.

questions.question: When should I book Emerald Yachts?
questions.answer: Booking 6 to 12 months in advance is recommended for best availability.

questions.question: Will I pay more booking through a travel advisor?
questions.answer: No. Pricing is the same, but planning expertise is added.

questions.question: Do I need a travel advisor?
questions.answer: Not required, but highly recommended for itinerary alignment and planning support.
